title: Safenet Reads Zero Bytes
summary: ENGINE BUG. SafenetPolicy checks only the length (SafenetPolicy.sol 113): 256 zero bytes (a batch list of 8 empty items) decode to epoch 0 and key (0,0) and fail isKnown, UntrustedAttestationKey (124).
lesson: Found by differential fuzzing; expectations are the on-chain outcome. Engine: MalformedAttestation for any non-attestation context (SafenetPolicy.ts).

steps.label: eight empty batch items as the context
